cmd.help: Show these commands, or one area's
cmd.on: Show displays again (for you, or a player)
cmd.off: Hide every display (for you, or a player)
cmd.create: Turn your wand selection into a display
cmd.info: Owner, id, position, size and media of a display
cmd.name: Show a display's name, set it, or clear it with reset
cmd.video.clear: Take the video off a display for everyone
cmd.speed: Show or set a shared display's playback speed
cmd.mode: Show or set a display's playback mode
cmd.stats: How every viewer's playback of a display is doing; all: one line per display
cmd.schedule.show: What is scheduled on a display
cmd.schedule.play: Start playback at a time (now if left off)
cmd.schedule.pause: Pause playback at a time (now if left off)
cmd.queue.add: Add a video at the end
cmd.queue.move: Move entry n to another position
cmd.queue.loop: Show or set whether finished videos go back to the end
cmd.karaoke.status: Singers, leads, latencies, trims and the line
cmd.karaoke.stop: Stop every singer and empty the line
cmd.karaoke.trim: Shift every singer's voice later (+) or earlier (-), in ms
cmd.karaoke.singer: Add, remove or trim a singer
cmd.karaoke.singer.add: Make a player the singer (duet: add one more), optional lead in ms
cmd.karaoke.singer.trim: Shift one singer's voice, in ms
cmd.karaoke.join: Join the singer line with a song link
cmd.karaoke.line.add: Put a player in the line with a song link
cmd.karaoke.line.remove: Take a player out of the line
cmd.prepare.start: Load a display on players ahead, so its start is instant
cmd.fullscreen.start: Play a display or link over players' whole screen
cmd.share.stop: End the screen share on a display
cmd.share.list: Displays with a screen share running
cmd.config: Show or change server-wide settings in config.toml
cmd.policy: Show or change one display's policy overrides
cmd.diag.clients: Mod versions, and each online player's client build
cmd.diag.env: A player's client environment (OS, GPU, yt-dlp, FFmpeg)
cmd.diag.loglevel: Show or set how much a player's client logs
cmd.diag.errors: Recent client errors, hitches, shares and display commands
cmd.area.displays: Displays — create, find and manage them
cmd.area.schedule: Schedule — play or pause a display at a set time
cmd.area.queue: Queue — videos that play after the current one
cmd.area.karaoke: Karaoke — singers, their timing and the singer line
cmd.area.prepare: Prepare — load a display on players ahead of an event
cmd.area.fullscreen: Fullscreen — play a video over players' whole screen
cmd.area.diag: Diagnostics — clients, environments, logs and errors
cmd.area.viewing: Viewing — turn displays on or off for a player
